full_judgment: and the same was adopted by the other concussed by saying “আল্লাহ যো বাতায়া ইউ ভি মেরা বাত হ্যায়” except Bangladeshi co-accused. A Quddus who made his own statement in Bengali under section 342 CrPC including the alleged confessions On consideration of the evidence and other materials on record and the facts and circumstances of the case the learned Special Tribunal found 5 of the accused namely, Raja A. Majid, Nobab Khan, Md. Abdullah, Sadullah Khan and Wasim Aslam guilty and convicted them under section 25(1) of the Special Powers Act 1974 and sentenced each of them to death by hanging and found the other 2 accused namely, Abdul Majid Anowar, A. Quddus @ Babul guilty under section 25D of the Special Powers Act, 1974 and sentenced each of them to suffer RI for 14 years and also to pay a fine of Taka 5,000.00 in default to suffer RI for 3 months more vide judgment and order dated 1-10-1991 as stated above. In pursuance of the aforesaid judgment and order of conviction and sentence the above death reference has been referred to us for confirmation of the deaths of the condemned prisoners as Death Reference No. 41 of 1991 but being aggrieved by the said judgment and order of conviction and sentence, all the 7 convicts have preferred Jail Appeal being No. 1877 of 1991 and also a regular appeal being Criminal Appeal No. 1991 of 1991 in this court as aforesaid which have been heard together and are being disposed of by a single judgment.
